fields.description: A flattened view of Event Type so every chart and card is a single equality filter instead of a list of event types that must be kept in sync in six places.
fields.label: Outcome

fields.description: Set when sshd said the account does not exist. Distinguishes someone guessing your password from someone guessing your usernames.
fields.label: Invalid User

fields.description: A Link, not free text, so the geolocation and history of an address live in one place and every event drills through to it.
fields.label: Source IP

fields.description: Country the source IP resolved to, copied from the IP record by the geolocation backfill. Deliberately Data rather than a Link to Country: frappe fills an empty Link->Country field with the site's own default country on insert, which on an audit log does not mean 'unknown' — it means every login silently claims to come from head office. Dashboard Chart groups by this field identically either way.
fields.label: Country

fields.description: password, publickey, keyboard-interactive/pam, none, gssapi-with-mic — stored as free text because a build with extra auth modules can emit values an enum would silently drop.
fields.label: Auth Method

fields.description: Only populated when sshd runs at LogLevel VERBOSE. Tells you WHICH key was used.
fields.label: Key Fingerprint

fields.description: Groups every event from one sshd connection. sshd forks a child per connection, so its pid is the correlation key; the boot id is prefixed so pid reuse across a reboot cannot merge two unrelated logins.
fields.label: Session Key

fields.description: The kernel's own login-session id. This is the reliable link between an SSH login and the sudo commands that login went on to run.
fields.label: Audit Session

fields.description: 'fixture' means the row came from a replayed test fixture, not from this machine. Those rows exist so the dashboard can be demonstrated on a box with no sshd.
fields.label: Ingest Source

fields.description: The complete original log message. Kept so that an event whose meaning we have not yet written a rule for is still recoverable after the fact.
fields.label: Raw Message
